title: Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered
provenance: Reported by moffatluke (highball-db#99, 2026-09-17), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27, Highball 0.9.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, rated 5 of 5 after 84 minutes. Graphics mode not stated. Not verified by the maintainer. BabySatan5282 (highball-db#278, 2026-10-02), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.7.1, Highball 0.10.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r17, DXMT as the environment's mode (the game is DirectX 12 only, so its own mode was most likely D3DMetal), rated 3 of 5, playable with workarounds, after 17 minutes, with a fuller review promised. The same reporter's second report (highball-db#306, 2026-10-04), same Mac, macOS and engine, rates it 3 of 5 again after 57 minutes, the workarounds still not named. sahilas (highball-db#604, 2026-10-21), Apple M5, macOS 27, Highball 0.10.21, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29 as reported, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 with nothing named as off and no session length.
notes: Reported perfect over an 84-minute session on an M5 Pro, 60 to 120 fps on medium to high settings with the game's own frame generation turned on. The game is DirectX 12 only, so the mode was almost certainly D3DMetal, but the reporter did not state it. No measurement here yet. Two warning dialogs appear at launch and can be dismissed with OK, one about the graphics driver being below requirements and one claiming no graphics card is installed; both come from the game reading a driver version D3DMetal does not report. The reporter also had to switch the game to windowed mode, fullscreen did not work. A second reporter on an M4 Pro (engine r17, Highball 0.10.2) rates it 3, playable with workarounds, after a 17-minute first look and again after 57 minutes, the workarounds not yet named either time. A later report on a base M5 (macOS 27, D3DMetal on the default engine line) rates it 4, playable with minor issues, without naming them.

knownIssues.symptom: Two warnings at launch, 'driver below the current game requirements' and 'no installed graphics card has been detected' (reported on an M5 Pro)
knownIssues.cause: the game reads a driver version and adapter identity that D3DMetal does not report the way a Windows driver does
knownIssues.fix: click OK on both, the game runs

knownIssues.symptom: Fullscreen does not work, the game had to be switched to windowed (reported on an M5 Pro)
knownIssues.cause: not measured; matches the fullscreen mode-switch limitation on macOS (highball#72)
knownIssues.fix: use windowed or borderless in the game's display settings
